registers.name: GICR_IIDR
registers.description: Redistributor Implementer Identification Register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: ProductID
fields.description: Product Identifier. 此字段值为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。

fields.name: Variant
fields.description: 变体编号。通常用于区分产品变体或主要版本修订。 此字段值为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: 修订编号。通常用于区分产品的次要修订。 此字段值为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。

fields.name: Implementer
fields.description: 包含 JEP106 manufacturer's identification code of the designer of the 再分发器. The code identifies the designer of the component, which might not be the same as the implementer of the device containing the component. Zero is not a valid JEP106 identification code, meaning a value of zero for GICR_IIDR indicates this 寄存器 is not implemented. For an 实现 designed by Arm, this 字段 reads as 0x43B. Bits [11:8] contain the JEP106 bank identifier of the designer minus 1. Bit 7 is RES0. Bits [6:0] contain bits [6:0] of the JEP106 manufacturer's identification code of the designer. 此字段值为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。
